_comment: Copy this to data/donations.json and fill in your own details.
data/ is gitignored, so your addresses never reach the repository.
Remove any method you do not offer. Remove the file entirely and the donation
topic disappears from the ticket panel.
Every entry needs asset, network and address. 'memo' is optional and only
applies to chains that require a memo or destination tag, such as XRP or XLM.
The network string is shown to the donor as the thing they must match in their
wallet, so write it the way their wallet writes it.
